correctness.rationale: For each prime p>=7, central map R_{p-7}->R_{p+5} has dimension n=p-6 with Toeplitz entries c_{6+j-i}(lambda) from f_lambda^3. Opposite triangular forms at lambda=0 and leading lambda^3 coefficient give constant and leading determinant (-1)^n and degree exactly 3n. At lambda=-1 parity of the socle pairing yields a rectangular odd/even coupling block; the explicitly computed m x m Toeplitz minor satisfies D_m=(-1)^m binom(m+2,2)= +/-15/8 mod p, nonzero. This proves exact corank 1, including p=7. GL_2 change of variables induces a truncated ring automorphism by Frobenius and transports to lambda=2 and 1/2. The lambda=0 triangular witness in every graded piece yields generic rank (p-6)^2 for full multiplication, but only <=(p-6)^2-1 at harmonic parameters; no assertion about other zeros. Independent modular elimination checked seven primes across harmonic and nonharmonic parameters.
